costs.measurement: Batch4 mean of 10 timed forwards after warmup; query encoding included, reference prefix cached. Not image I/O/preprocessing or cold-start latency.

outcome_groups.denominator: OA: full N. BA: number of present classes times each full-cohort class count. Pass contributions are additive, not mean pass BA.

final_gallery.rule: At most two new queries/dataset: one rescue and one harm when available; exclude all previous gallery queries. Prefer outside-development, source-offset-unreproduced outcomes, then new-vs-CE, aligned-vs-pooled and margin change. Deterministic.
final_gallery.references: Actual fixed reference manifest; exclude identical ID/MMSI; first two same/rival class entries in bank order. No resizing.
final_gallery.limitation: Outcome-selected examples are not population proportions. Bank order is not learned attention ranking. No new per-reference attention trace or physical causal evidence.
